name: Gekka Kaidan
source: The main character, who had been completely drenched by a sudden downpour, sought shelter from the rain in a abandoned Western-style mansion. Coincidentally, a mysterious young man appeared and they decided to pass the time by sharing scary stories.
translation: 主角被突如其来的倾盆大雨淋得浑身湿透，在一栋废弃的洋楼里避雨。巧合的是，一位神秘的年轻人出现了，他们决定通过分享恐怖故事来打发时间。
